content_sections.heading: CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 19th August 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Botany, Zoology, Fishery, Forestry, Environmental Science, Chemistry, or Geology to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant-II post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview on the specified date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant-II position will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the job is contractual in nature for the duration of the project.
